text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro Ramonu with a calm, composed 
smile...! Winning this year's Hanshin JF, 
Mejiro Ramonu lives up to all expectations 
with overwhelming brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh...! Mejiro Ramonu... s-she's so 
strong...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was simply masterful, Lady Ramonu... 
She already feels like the face of her 
generation...

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The Best Junior Queen Umamusume is 
definitely going to be Lady Ramonu!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Could we... actually witness it? The first 
Triple Tiara in history...!
(Waaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...Mejiro Ramonu-san is amazing. I can 
hardly believe we're the same kind of 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"Somehow... when someone is that 
overwhelmingly dominant, —it just makes 
you look up to them."

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaah... Mejiro Ramonu-san... is 
incredible...!

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
“How can it be so beautiful? How can it be 
so strong...!”

text_block_list.name: A Certain Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
To think I'll be able to chase that back 
again next year... I'm so happy—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...This heat. All these emotions swirling 
together, driving it higher... This 
temperature.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —More... I want to yearn even more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I want to love you... enough to burn away 
completely...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It's there. Surely... right over there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Along the path that revolves around the 
Tiara...—

Having finished her first GⅠ race, Mejiro 
Ramonu was... smiling, just like she did 
after her debut.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I imagine so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
All that's left is to get this body 
perfectly in tune.

The races to challenge in next year's 
Classic year... the Oka Sho, the Oaks, and 
the Shuka Sho. —The goal is a clean sweep: 
the Triple Tiara.
choice_data_list: First, the first race: the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Only once in a lifetime... The chance to 
seize that brilliance comes only once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: A magnificent passion will surely be born.

Her prophetic words send shivers down my 
spine... Something big is bound to happen 
on next year's Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a foolish question to ask.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —I'm looking forward to it. Very much so.

And so, aiming for the first-ever Triple 
Tiara in the upcoming Classic season... 
she takes on the challenge of the "Oka 
Sho"!
